- Source: Google Fonts, `ofl/notosanshebrew/NotoSansHebrew[wdth,wght].ttf`
- Upstream repository: https://github.com/google/fonts
- Upstream Git blob: `f31f73b8be8086692ff0156544f80975640e5a42`

- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1; see [OFL-NotoSansHebrew.txt](OFL-NotoSansHebrew.txt)

This unmodified font is included only as a test fixture for actual OpenType shaping
and CPU glyph rasterization. The font is not a runtime dependency.
